title: Understanding KDE
text: Kernel Density Estimates (KDEs) are useful for visualizing the distribution of data. They can help identify patterns such as bimodality, where a distribution has two distinct peaks.

title: Analyzing the Plot
text: Look at the distribution of nugget weights for each shape in the plot. Consider whether there are multiple peaks or clusters in the data for any shape.

title: Using KDEs for Bimodality
text: Can overlaid KDEs help determine if the distribution of nugget weights is bimodal for a given shape?
